UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user of the AgriShare application, defining their role and basic profile information. Authentication is handled by an external system.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

role.description: The role of the user within the AgriShare application, determining their access rights (e.g., ADMIN, INVESTOR, MANAGER, EMPLOYEE).

address.description: Optional physical address of the user.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was last updated.

Investment.title: Investment
Investment.description: Records an investment made by a user into the AgriShare farm's operational activity.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Investment entity.

investorId.description: Reference to the UserProfile (INVESTOR role) who made this investment. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Investment)

amount.description: The monetary amount of the investment.

investmentDate.description: The date and time when the investment was made.

description.description: Optional description or notes about the investment.

recordedByUserId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who recorded this investment. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Investment)

Transaction.title: Transaction
Transaction.description: Represents a financial entry (income) or exit (expense) transaction for the farm's accounting.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Transaction entity.

type.description: The type of transaction, either 'INCOME' or 'EXPENSE'.

category.description: The category of the transaction (e.g., 'Egg Sales', 'Chicken Sales', 'Feed', 'Medication', 'Salaries', 'Maintenance', 'Other Income', 'Other Expense').

amount.description: The monetary amount of the transaction.

transactionDate.description: The date and time when the transaction occurred.

description.description: Optional detailed description of the transaction.

recordedByUserId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who recorded this transaction. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Transaction)

ProductionRecord.title: ProductionRecord
ProductionRecord.description: Stores daily production data for the poultry farm, including egg count, mortality, and total number of chickens.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ProductionRecord entity.

recordDate.description: The date and time for which this production record applies.

eggsProduced.description: The total number of eggs produced on this date.

mortalityCount.description: The number of chickens that died on this date.

totalChickens.description: The total number of chickens present on the farm at the time of this record.

recordedByUserId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who entered this production data. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N ProductionRecord)

ProfitDistribution.title: ProfitDistribution
ProfitDistribution.description: Records the distribution of profits to individual investors or the decision to reinvest profits.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ProfitDistribution entity.

investorId.description: Reference to the UserProfile (INVESTOR role) who is receiving or reinvesting this profit share. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N ProfitDistribution)

distributionDate.description: The date and time when this profit distribution was recorded.

amount.description: The monetary amount distributed or earmarked for reinvestment for this investor.

isReinvested.description: Indicates if this amount was reinvested into the farm activity (true) or paid out (false).

notes.description: Optional notes regarding this profit distribution.

recordedByUserId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who recorded this profit distribution. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N ProfitDistribution)

ActivityLog.title: ActivityLog
ActivityLog.description: Tracks significant actions performed within the application for transparency and auditing purposes.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ActivityLog entity.

description.description: A detailed description of the action, including changes if applicable.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who performed the action. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N ActivityLog)

timestamp.description: The date and time when the action was performed.

relatedEntityId.description: Optional: The ID of the entity affected by this action.

relatedEntityType.description: Optional: The type of the entity affected (e.g., 'Investment', 'Transaction', 'UserProfile').

FarmAsset.title: FarmAsset
FarmAsset.description: Represents a fixed asset of the farm, such as land and buildings, which is separate from the operational activity.

id.description: Unique identifier for the FarmAsset entity.

name.description: The name of the farm asset (e.g., 'Land', 'Poultry House 1').

description.description: A description of the farm asset.

initialValue.description: The initial monetary value of the farm asset when acquired.

acquisitionDate.description: The date and time when the farm asset was acquired.

currentValue.description: The estimated current monetary value of the farm asset, potentially adjusted for depreciation or appreciation.

isOperationalAsset.description: Indicates if this asset is directly used in farm operations (e.g., poultry house) or is a passive asset (e.g., land for future expansion).

recordedByUserId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who recorded or last updated this farm asset. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N FarmAsset)

FarmAssetOwnership.title: FarmAssetOwnership
FarmAssetOwnership.description: Defines the ownership stake of a user in a specific farm asset, including their percentage of property.

id.description: Unique identifier for the FarmAssetOwnership entity.

farmAssetId.description: Reference to the FarmAsset being owned. (Relationship: FarmAsset 1:N FarmAssetOwnership)

ownerId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who is an owner of this asset. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N FarmAssetOwnership)

ownershipPercentage.description: The percentage of ownership this user holds in the specific farm asset (e.g., 25.5).

startDate.description: The date and time when this ownership stake became effective.

endDate.description: Optional: The date and time when this ownership stake ceased or changed.

notes.description: Optional notes regarding this specific ownership record.

recordedByUserId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who recorded or last updated this ownership record. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N FarmAssetOwnership)

firestore.reasoning:
The recommended Firestore structure for AgriShare prioritizes secure, scalable, and debuggable authorization by strictly adhering to the core design principles. 

**Authorization Independence via Denormalization:**
Each document crucial for authorization (e.g., Investment, ProfitDistribution, FarmAssetOwnership) directly includes the `investorId` or `ownerId` field. This denormalization eliminates the need for `get()` calls in security rules to traverse parent collections or related user profiles to determine access to a specific record. For example, an investor's ability to view their specific investments or profit distributions will be directly checked against `request.auth.uid == resource.data.investorId` without needing to fetch a parent user document. Similarly, `recordedByUserId` in Transaction, ProductionRecord, and ActivityLog documents ensures that write access can be granted based on the user's role and their specific action, maintaining an audit trail.

The only `get()` operation for authorization will be to fetch the user's own profile (`/users/{userId}`) to determine their global role (e.g., ADMIN, MANAGER, EMPLOYEE, INVESTOR). This is a self-referential check (`get(/users/$(request.auth.uid)).data.role`) and is not considered a hierarchical dependency on parent data in the context of avoiding transactional breaks or debugging complexity. It ensures DBAC without relying on custom claims.

**QAPs (Rules are not Filters):**
The structure supports secure `list` operations by employing Structural Segregation and careful use of denormalized fields.

1.  **Role-Based Read Access:** Collections like `transactions`, `productionRecords`, `activityLogs`, and `farmAssets` are structured for broad read access for relevant roles (e.g., INVESTORs can read all transactions for transparency). Security rules will ensure that only authorized roles can `list` and `get` these collections. For example, an INVESTOR can list all `transactions`, but only a MANAGER or ADMIN can create or update them.
2.  **User-Specific Filterable Collections:** For collections where users should only see their own data, such as `investments` and `profitDistributions` for `INVESTOR`s, the `investorId` field is included in each document. Security rules will mandate that `list` requests from an INVESTOR must include a `where('investorId', '==', request.auth.uid)` clause. This ensures that the application client cannot request unauthorized data and the database only returns records explicitly owned by the requesting user, preventing security rule violations.
3.  **Segregation of Data Posture:** All documents within a given collection share a homogeneous security posture. For instance, `transactions` are all general financial records with clear read/write access defined by roles. There are no mixed public/private records in the same collection. This simplifies security rules significantly.

**Overall Structure:**
*   `users/{userId}`: User profiles with their role for global authorization checks.
*   `investments/{investmentId}`: Centralized investments, with `investorId` and `recordedByUserId` for specific investor views and audit trails.
*   `transactions/{transactionId}`: All financial transactions, globally accessible for reading by investors, but restricted write access for managers/admins.
*   `productionRecords/{recordId}`: Daily production data, writeable by employees, readable by all relevant roles.
*   `profitDistributions/{distributionId}`: Profit records for individual investors, viewable only by the respective `investorId`.
*   `activityLogs/{logId}`: An immutable audit log, readable for transparency by authorized personnel.
*   `farmAssets/{assetId}`: Fixed farm assets, managed by admins, viewable by others.
*   `farmAssets/{assetId}/ownerships/{ownershipId}`: Nested subcollection for detailed ownership of specific assets, allowing investors to see their stakes (`ownerId`).

This design leverages explicit field-based authorization (`investorId`, `ownerId`, `recordedByUserId`) to achieve robust QAPs and authorization independence, making security rules simpler to write, understand, and debug.
